{{Quote|Trista, inform the ''Daphoros'' that Master Solusar will be joining the boarding company as its commander. And suggest to the Lady Commander that she send her best assault team on this mission.|[[Tenel Ka Djo]] to [[Trista Zel]]|<ref name="apocalypse" />}}
An '''unidentified female noble''' served as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Hapan]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Daphoros]]'' in the [[Hapan Royal Navy]]. Sometime in [[44 ABY]], the ''Daphoros'' participated in the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the [[New Jedi Order]] from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], after the [[Jedi academy|academy]] came under attack by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. During the evacuation, it was ordered to lock the Hapan transport ''[[Sharmok 718]]'', suspected to have been captured by the Sith, under a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], then send an assault team under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kam Solusar]] to retake the vessel.<ref name="apocalypse" />
